title: Full pool — a HEADLESS wallet wins, and neither founder wallet does
poolIdNote: Deliberately unnamed. T4 was frozen against pool 15, lost that pool to the seal-lockout (DRIFT §H6) and ran unedited on pool 16 — which made the prediction stronger evidence, not weaker, because it was fixed before the pool existed. T5 is frozen the same way on purpose. The pool is recorded in T5.freeze.json when the first entry lands.
hypothesis: The winner of a Blotto Cup pool is decided by the allocations and nothing else. T4 showed a pool paying the operator's own account the whole pot; it could not show that the account was not privileged, because that account won. T5 inverts it: a headless wallet takes rank 1 and the entire 4 SOL pot, another headless wallet takes last, and both founder wallets are ordinary entrants who finish in the middle and are paid nothing.

unconditionalDerivation._: What follows from the shapes alone — no seed, no exact numbers, no assumption about what the founder dials.
unconditionalDerivation.scoringRule: A stat goes to the larger number. A battle goes to whoever wins at least 3 of 5 stats, otherwise it is a draw. Score is 2 half-points a win and 1 a draw, across 7 battles against each of the other 63 entrants.
unconditionalDerivation.winnerIsHeadless: W00 holds three stats at 26 or above in every battle; no field seat exceeds 25 and the pole holds one stat. So W00 wins all 434 battles against the field and never loses to the pole: its floor is 875. Every field seat loses all 7 battles to W00, so the best any of them can reach is 868, which is below that floor. **W00 is rank 1 whatever anyone else does, including the founder.**
unconditionalDerivation.founderSeatsCannotWin: UI-A and UI-B hold every stat between 1 and 25, so they are field seats by the line above and cannot take rank 1. This holds for ANY allocation inside that range — it does not depend on the founder reproducing the recipe.
unconditionalDerivation.founderSeatsCannotComeLast: Five non-zero stats beat a single spike four stats to one, so UI-A and UI-B each beat the pole in all 7 battles — at least 14 half-points. The pole scores at most 7. **So both founder seats finish in ranks 2..63.** The non-zero floor is what carries this: a seat with two or more zeroes can draw with a pole instead of beating it.
unconditionalDerivation.poleIsLast: Every field seat beats the pole in every battle, so W01 scores 0 against all 62 of them and at most 7 against W00. The worst any field seat can do is 14, from the pole alone. **W01 is last whatever the field does.**

expectations.sealReason: Capacity — the 64th register seals the pool immediately
expectations.founderRankNote: A RANGE, not a number, and deliberately so. UI-A and UI-B play by hand against a 90-second clock; T4 showed that produces different numbers from any recipe (§H10). Their exact ranks among 61 other field seats are COMPUTED AT REVEAL, not predicted. The nominal allocations below are what the recipe produces and are the conditional case.
expectations.conditionalNote: The root, the leaf order, every exact score and every field rank assume the exact allocations below AND the planned seat order. A founder allocation inside 1..25 that is not the recipe breaks these and none of the unconditional claims above.
detectionNotes: Detection computes and persists a report but flags nobody, under the manual-only policy ruling D-E9. No flag, no escrow, no delay to the payout.

population_score is predicted to fire on W00 — it is many sigma from the field by design, exactly as it did on UI-A in T4. Finding it there is a detection PASS, not a fault. That it fires on a HEADLESS wallet this time is itself worth recording: the signal follows the allocation, not the route.
allocation_entropy raises its round-number note on W01: a pole is all zeroes and a hundred, so 100% of its stat values are multiples of ten.
allocation_entropy must NOT fire "strong" on anyone: every seat carries at least 3 distinct shapes (UI-A and UI-B carry 5 each, W00 7, W01 5, the field 7).
duplicate_sets must not fire. UI-A and UI-B rotate through different stats precisely so their seven-battle sets differ — two entrants sharing a set is the one allocation signal that hard-blocks.
Sanctions screening runs on the winner before payment. W00 is a derived devnet key and no match is expected.

seats.recipe: each battle, drag ONE stat to 25 and leave the rest — in order: Strength, Speed, Heart, Wit, Durability, Strength, Heart. Never take a stat above 25 or down to 0.
each battle, drag ONE stat to 25 and leave the rest — in order: Durability, Wit, Heart, Speed, Strength, Wit, Speed. Never take a stat above 25 or down to 0.

seatNote: `seat` is null until the pool runs. `plannedSeat` is the index this plan assumes; only the root and the leaf order depend on it.
contingency: If a headless seat seals and then fails to register it is barred from the pool for good (DRIFT §H6) and enter.ts stops the run (§H8). Replace it from the spare roster with --substitute, which makes the spare play THAT SEAT'S frozen allocation, so the scored field stays the planned field. If the seat that burns is W00, the WINNER changes wallet but not allocation — record it and say so plainly.
If the founder plays an allocation inside 1..25 that is not the recipe, the unconditional expectations hold and the two UI seats reconcile as INPUT_DRIFT — as they did in T4.
If a founder seat takes a stat ABOVE 25, it is no longer a field seat and could beat W00. That would be a genuine FAIL of the test as designed, not of the product, and the rerun is on the next pool.
If fewer than 64 land before the deadline, the pool seals at whatever it holds provided that is at least 40, and still plays and pays. The engineered roles are unaffected.
passCriteria: The pool reaches Paid with 64 entrants.
Exactly one seat is paid; it is **W00**, a headless wallet, and the amount is the whole 4000000000 lamport pot.
NEITHER founder wallet is paid, and both finish between rank 2 and rank 63.
Every revealed allocation reproduces the battles_hash the chain recorded at entry.
The recomputed results root equals the on-chain results_root.
No seat is flagged and no sanctions hold is placed.
